claims.claim_text: President Obama's executive order established what the platform calls unprecedented ethics rules for former executive-branch personnel and officials' acceptance of lobbyist gifts.
President Obama and Democrats were fighting to reduce money's influence in politics.
President Obama and Democrats were holding Congress to higher conflict-of-interest standards.
